scope: Shared admission and per-operation data scratch for ordinary independent reads of the same mounted filesystem; exclusive metadata mutation and exact lifetime retained.

implementation.admission: 26 existing drive lanes; at most16 distinct reader task incarnations per lane, nested depth bounded. Original mutation owner retained before exclusive admission, ascending lanes. Pending writer prevents new readers; exact existing recursion allowed. No own read-to-write promotion. Nested cross-drive requests remain non-waiting even while an outer payload has returned its backend. Runtime owns resident metadata only; native queues and exact cancellation handle waits. Existing contention/timeout counters include new admission waits.
implementation.backend: Path and attribute metadata still serialize. Only explicitly passed exact native read Guard plus matching mounted reference may return the backend for its synchronous payload; shared admission, volume Use and native unwind stay alive. RAII must reacquire backend before caller continuation. No Rust mutable borrow/no-sleep owner over I/O or caller faults.
implementation.fat: Existing local data sectors preserved. Extent/LRU/append snapshots and publication synchronized by original short metadata owner; caller names staged outside it.
implementation.ntfs: Local attribute copied under original metadata backend. 512-byte private sector scratch per read; compressed reads alone optionally allocate128KB for two64KB buffers outside owner. If unavailable, original serialized resident scratch path. Native mounted work_counters remain false, no global counter race in borrowed payload.
implementation.preserved: Public Contract/SDK/API/ABI, block/device lifetime, canonical cache/index/publication and writeback, disk format, metadata barriers, existing copy per-chunk mutation reservation, streams, shutdown/recovery and STANDARD workload/reference.

host_buffer_boundaries.scope: Actual buffer-owner code, modeled heap/backend/admission/data-I/O. Exact private scratch and memory-pressure/late-admission fallback; native compression semantics tested separately.
